label: LightONKaroo
description: Manual ANT+ and Bluetooth bike light control for Hammerhead Karoo 3 with Software Threat Mode.
releaseNotes:
* UI Modernization: In-card expanding light cards with Slide-to-Activate
* High-contrast styling: 25% Karoo Turquoise and 25% Karoo Red boxes
* Advanced Light Modes: 100% dynamic passthrough of all ANT+ modes with on-demand refresh
* 100% Karoo Profile Editor gesture compatibility (long-press drag & double-tap edit/delete)
